registration_scope: Relative local OHRC-to-TMC-2 correspondence for OHRC native samples 1000-11000 and lines 42000-58000 where camera/DTM support exists, reported on native TMC-2 5 m ortho pixels
reasons_for_limited_scope: Earlier frozen full-strip affine transfer failed outside the local region.
The independently corroborated navigation displacement was resolved at LOLA 120 m scale, not surveyed at TMC 5 m scale.

accepted_controls.note: Method counts overlap and must not be summed as distinct physical ground-control points.
